description: This source file implements a factory for creating N2 connection clients, including local stub and SCTP-based clients, with associated notifiers for NGAP message handling and conversion between packed and unpacked NGAP PDUs.

classes.name: sctp_to_n2_pdu_notifier
classes.description: Converts packed NGAP PDUs from N2 GW into unpacked NGAP messages and forwards them to CU-CP.

classes.name: n2_to_sctp_pdu_notifier
classes.description: Converts unpacked NGAP messages from CU-CP into packed NGAP PDUs and forwards them to SCTP gateway.

classes.name: ngap_gateway_local_stub
classes.description: Stub implementation of n2_connection_client for local NGAP handling without a core.

classes.name: n2_sctp_gateway_client
classes.description: Handles SCTP connection to the network for NGAP messages, using IO broker and SCTP network client.

methods.name: handle_cu_cp_connection_request
methods.description: Handles incoming NGAP connection requests from CU-CP, returning a notifier for NGAP messages.

methods.name: handle_tx_message
methods.description: Handles transmission of NGAP messages, including encoding and generating NG Setup responses.

methods.name: send_rx_pdu_to_cu_cp
methods.description: Encodes and forwards NGAP messages to CU-CP, with optional PCAP logging.
